company.name: Damac Properties
company.shortDescription: DAMAC Properties develops residential, commercial, and leisure properties, creating skyscrapers, communities, and branded residences.
company.description: DAMAC Properties, a subsidiary of DAMAC Group, is a real estate developer specializing in residential, commercial, and leisure properties. The company has built a portfolio that includes skyscrapers, communities, and branded residences across various locations. Since its establishment, DAMAC has completed thousands of homes and continues to develop new projects. Its developments contribute to urban expansion and infrastructure growth in the regions where they are located.
